explication: Ory Kratos is an API-first identity and user-management server. Clients initiate self-service login and registration, then use verification, recovery, and account-management flows; administrators also manage identities through APIs. The repository tree identifies the runtime entry points, domain managers, persistence layer, and delivery components, while the README documents the principal capabilities. Source excerpts are limited, so the graph shows only a small number of internal call or persistence relationships where the excerpts support them; feature nodes are not intended to imply a fully inspected route pipeline.
